none: PAS NLM-F10BD5: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constans
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Constans (333-350), Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-341, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust rosette diademed draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [--]STANS PF AVG. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them; the vexillum bears a triangular device. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXER]CITVS. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 16.0mm, Weight: 1.23gms, die axis: 12
